node.title: Marco semántico común de una intersección
node.summary: Observers can compose predicates when question, domain, event, provenance and time match.

relations: Distributed field observations can be combined meaningfully only after their question, event, scope and time references have been aligned.
La condición matemática de 2026 es una lente posterior; el corredor no se presenta como experimento de intersección residual.
A task-specific collective property could support a minimal handoff, but it must not erase the piece identity and provenance needed by the receiving decision.
Es una posibilidad de diseño, no un sistema de autenticidad validado ni sustituto de identificar la pieza cuando la pregunta lo exige.
A nonempty shared region does not itself prove generative value; the link from the joint property to a usable capability must be established separately.
Comparación conceptual entre dominios; la geometría sintética no valida una institución o una integración real.
